items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1962-02-06
items.q: Yeah, from up in New York called George Trump.

ctx.x: That was the bar club. There was nothing to it. You weren't playing nothing. You were playing little head tunes and screeching summertime, you know, on a sopranos sax. There was nothing to it. You get on the stand and play 15 minutes like that and get off, you know? Yeah. There was no dancing or nothing. No dancing? Only piano, trumpets, drums, and sopranos sax.
Yeah, from up in New York called George Trump. George Trump.
